rule: Live-looking means confirmed ages, a listed fee or a per-centre confirmed fee program, and at least one real photo. /photos/wpg/ aerials, placeholders, and the harvested $218 catalogue fee do not count.

productionSearch.note: SSR payload for that search. Nearby SQL caps at 400. Includes a few metro rows whose pins fall in the Winnipeg radius.

repoCatalogue.note: Public rows whose city matches Winnipeg, Wpg, or the Winnpeg typo. Claims are not in the JSON catalogue, so platform Live is 0 here even if Neon has a claim.

afterTooling.note: This change does not write ages, fees, or photos. Live-looking stays 0% until a sourced fill is applied.
